title: SB 765 / HB 786 (Public Chapter 108) (112th General Assembly, 2021) — Exception to the handgun-carry offense for persons 21+ (or 18+ veterans/service members) carrying openly or concealed; also firearm theft penalties and sentencing
operative_text:
Sec. 1 adds 39-17-1307(g): exception for carrying a handgun openly or concealed: It is an exception to the application of subsection (a) that a person is carrying, whether openly or concealed, a handgun and:
Secs. 2-5 amend 39-17-1313 vehicle storage so it applies to a person who carries lawfully under 39-17-1307: a person who lawfully carries a handgun pursuant to § 39-17-1307(9) may, unless expressly prohibited by federal law, transport and store a firearm
Secs. 6-7 amend 39-17-1351(n)(1) and 39-17-1366(e): permit holder must carry permit when carrying where otherwise prohibited: shall display the permit on demand of a law enforcement officer under such circumstances.
Secs. 8-10 amend 39-14-105 theft grading and penalty for theft of a firearm: Theft of a firearm shall be punished by confinement for not less than one hundred eighty (180) days in addition to any other penalty authorized by law.
Sec. 11 adds 40-35-114(29) enhancement factor: The offense involved the theft of a firearm from a motor vehicle, as defined in § 55-1-103;
Sec. 12 adds 40-35-501(x): release eligibility: there shall be no release eligibility until the person has served eighty-five percent (85%) of the sentence imposed by the court
Sec. 13 new offense for carrying a firearm while convicted of stalking, DUI, adjudicated mental defective, or federally prohibited: A person commits an offense who carries, with the intent to go armed, a firearm and:
Sec. 14 effective date: This act takes effect July 1, 2021, the public welfare requiring it, and applies to criminal offenses committed on or after that date.

other_topics: s.8-12 theft-of-firearm sentence, release eligibility (Q1 kind 2)

higher_law_duty: Sec. 13 refers to federal law ("Is otherwise prohibited from possessing a firearm by 18 U.S.C. 922(9) as it existed on January 1, 2021."); no duty on local bodies except the preemption clause in Sec. 2.
